source_policy.supplemental_matrix_source: Official Dacia UK accessory catalogue, May 2023, accessed through a document mirror
source_policy.compatibility_scope: The six compatibility columns reproduce the GB catalogue matrix only. They do not establish Polish MY2026 availability.

important_findings.finding: GB catalogue uses complete pack reference 7711948922, while the Polish 2022 price list exposes separate mounting and step references 768478691R and 8201741626.
GB catalogue calls references 7711574056 and 7711574057 400 L and 480 L; the Polish 2022 price list describes the same references as 330 L and 390 L.
GB catalogue uses 7711431405 for a 24 L 12V-220V cool box, while the Polish price list uses 7717277903 for a portable refrigerator.

GB catalogue supplies references 749020878R and 749022794R for five- and seven-seat rubber mats. These references are absent from the Polish 2022 price list and remain unconfirmed for the current Polish offer.
The complete Sleep Pack remains TBA in the GB matrix; box 984239528R, mattress 984247351R, tent 7717300226 and blinds 7717300430 are separate references.
GB catalogue exposes four complete towbar package references 7711949285-7711949288; the Polish price list instead exposes separate beam, mounting and wiring components.
The same radio references are called KMM-BT506DAB/KDC-BT740DAB in the GB catalogue and KMM-BT505DAB/KDC-BT730DAB in the Polish price list.
The GB catalogue contains both Premium and Premium Grip references, including 7711780255, while the Polish price list does not contain the Premium Grip reference.
No GB compatibility mark is interpreted as proof of current Polish grade, engine, transmission or model-year compatibility.
